fields.why:
Middlings control can often be sinusoidal using the incremental autospeed controller. This produces:
a) variable grind size
b) variable throughput

This influences flotation performance, particularly the variable throughput, which can result in variable mass pull to the cons circuit.

Currently, the flotation circuit does not appear to be particularly grind sensitive. When the autospeed controller’s max/min setpoints and increments/timing are changed, stable middlings throughput to the mill can be obtained, but it does not last due to the variable coarse/fines feed and DMS 3 split.
fields.design:
As we have previously set the Middlings Feeder 410-FE-1140 in manual to a ~2-hour average of middlings throughput with some success, it is proposed to use a calculation of CV1120 tonnes instead.

Since CV1725 (DMS 3 to Coarse Magsep) and CV1120 (to Middlings Bin) do not have weightometers, the proposed calculation would be: "CV1120 Calc = CV850 – CV1792". The weightometer values vary, however, so we propose incorporating a 1-2 hour average of each weightometer within the CV1120 calculation to minimize the variability.

The rationale behind this approach is to use the feed rate into the middlings bin as an input into the controller and to use the middlings bin level as a buffer to mitigate the variability in the feed entering the middlings bin. Additionally, the controller will retain the capability to adjust speed if the bin level becomes excessively high or low.

Risk mitigation should be incorporated within the design to allow the controller to be trialed and, if needed, revert back to the original design. This can be achieved by adding an enable/disable button.

Please consider incorporating this approach similar to the image below.
[Image in form – see source document] (Oscillating middlings bin level and middlings throughput trend; 410-FE-1140 faceplate mock-up with CV1120 calc, 30min/1hr/2hr avg and 'Enable use as current SP' option)
fields.impact: CROs can enable/disable feed-forward control on the 410-FE-1140 faceplate. Bin level high/low settings will be widened so the bin buffers feed variability.
